items.title: 12.8.1 Reactivity of sulfur (sulfur kitna react karta hai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.8.1 with Figure 12.7, printed page 280.

blocks.text: Sulfur aam taur par doosre sulfur atoms ke saath double bond ke bajaye single bonds banata hai, kyun ke is ke orbitals ka overlap (aapas mein chadhna) kamzor hota hai. Is liye sulfur atoms aapas mein jur kar bare molecules aur chains (zanjeer) banate hain; is process ko catenation kehte hain. S₈ taaj (crown) jaisa molecule hai (Figure 12.7).

blocks.alt: Aath S atoms single bonds se ek band, puckered (tedha-medha) ring (halqa) mein jure hain jo crown (taaj) jaisa dikhta hai: oopar paanch S atoms ki zigzag row aur neeche teen S atoms ki row, aur oopar wali row ke dono ends neeche wali row se jure hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.7: Cyclo-octasulfur, (S8) crown (taaj) jaisa molecule (kitab ki Figure 12.7 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.alt: Aath peele sulfur atoms aik aise ring mein single S-S bonds se jure hain jo chapta nahi: atoms bari bari oopar neeche hain, chaar oopar ki layer mein aur chaar neeche ki, is liye molecule crown (taaj) jaisa lagta hai. Halki grey rings dono layers ko dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Cyclo-octasulfur, S8 crown (taaj) jaisa molecule (Figure 12.7 jaisa original 3D model; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Sulfur double bonds ke bajaye S-S single bonds pasand karta hai kyunke us ke orbitals pehlu ba pehlu (sideways) achha overlap nahi karte, is liye woh rings aur chains banata hai (catenation). S8 mein har sulfur do doosre sulfur se juda hai aur S-S-S angle (zaviya) taqreeban 108 degree hai; yeh angle aath atoms ke chapte ring mein nahi samata, is liye ring mud kar taaj ki shakal le leta hai.

fallback.text: S8: aath sulfur atoms S-S single bonds ke mure hue ring mein, bari bari oopar neeche, taaj ki shakal mein.
fallback.alt: 3D model ki picture: Cyclo-octasulfur, S8 taaj-numa (crown) molecule.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki shakal 2D hai: aath S atoms ek ring banate hain aur har S do doosre S atoms se single bond se jura hai. Ring chapta nahi; atoms bari bari oopar aur neeche hain, is liye yeh taaj jaisa lagta hai. Neeche wala 3D model ghuma kar yahi oopar-neeche ki tarteeb dekhi ja sakti hai (model ka 108 degree ka angle hamari taraf se extra hai, kitab mein nahi).

blocks.prompt: Room temperature par sulfur kam reactive kyun hai (exercise Q.2g)?
blocks.explanation: Sulfur mazboot S–S single bonds se jure S₈ ke crown jaise rings ki shakal mein hota hai. 3p orbitals ka side-ways overlap kamzor hai, is liye woh reactive double bonds nahi banata. Ring torne ke liye energy chahiye, is liye sulfur zyada tar garam karne par hi react karta hai, jaise jal kar SO₂ banana.

items: Sulfur S–S single bonds banata hai (orbitals ka kamzor overlap), is liye catenation se rings aur chains.
